criteria: text accuracy first, no effect on runtime behaviour (overlay only, nothing published)
rules: romanised colour names are not readable to an English-speaking end user, so a descriptive English rendering wins over the corpus majority when the majority is pinyin
a descriptive rendering must be the one the corpus already uses where such a form exists; no new English is invented
where the corpus majority is non-idiomatic English, the standard industry wording wins and the change is recorded here with its reason

远山黛.reason: 黛 is a deep grey-green; the corpus already carries the descriptive form. Pinyin 'Yuanshan Dai' (150/158 rows) is unreadable in an English catalog.

千山翠.reason: 翠 is emerald green; the descriptive form is already in the corpus and reads as a colour.

玄天色.reason: 玄天 is the dark/mystic sky; '色' is a Chinese colour suffix that English names drop. Pinyin 'Xuantian Color' (14/29) is unreadable and half-translated.

玄空黑.reason: 玄空 is an empty/mystic void; black is the colour. All three corpus forms appear once, so consistency is the deciding factor.

自制配件.reason: capitalisation and hyphenation of the corpus's dominant form; 'Self-made Part' (500) and 'Self-manufactured Part' (52) are the same idea written three ways.

镀彩锌.reason: 彩锌 (chromate conversion coating) is 'iridescent zinc' in industry English; the corpus majority 'Color Zinc Plated' (57) is a literal calque that reads oddly. The corpus already carries the idiomatic form.

part:e7ae27a2d942bd85e6ace249.reason: the identifier is a lookup key; rewriting its inside would break exact-match search by code, which is a worse outcome for the running system than one Chinese glyph inside a code string. The human-readable part (控制板) is translated as Control Board.
part:e7ae27a2d942bd85e6ace249.effect: the integrity audit keeps reporting exactly one residual_cjk row; it is this one

总成 行里 total-numeric-separator 会把零件号内部的连字符拆开，而它的守卫 (?<![A-Z0-9]) 只保护全大写段；小写段（HA-20Ah-152S）漏网。会话#9 的 pn-hyphen-retight-us* 只覆盖 _ 后全大写段，同样漏掉小写。本规则的门禁限定「_ 分隔段内同时含小写字母与连字符-数字粘连」，from_pattern 要求空格两侧是 字母 - 数字+字母，只命中零件号内部，不碰 Assembly - 086 Manual 这类真正的饰面分隔符（把守卫放宽会丢掉 10 行正确分格，故不采用）。
护脚 族语料 88:10 支持 Foot Guard；既有 foot-guard 规则只吃 Foot Shield，漏掉 Foot Support。护栏 (?<!Guard) 必需：另有 8 行源文是「支脚+护脚」两个词，译文 Foot Support Guard 里的 Support 属「支脚」，朴素替换会产出 Foot Guard Guard。
合件 既有规则只覆盖 Combined Part / Combination，漏掉 Set；语料 610:4 明确支持 Assembly。

缝条 既有规则只吃 Gap Seal / Gap Strip；裸 Weatherstrip 漏网，而 Weatherstrip 在语料里是「密封条」的译法。语料 28:4。
